map.问题密度怎么用？: How should I use issue density?
map.密度 = 问题数 ÷ 句数。低于 0.5 通常可接受，0.5~1.5 建议逐句修: Density = issues ÷ sentences. Below 0.5 is usually acceptable, 0.5–1.5 suggests sentence-by-sentence revision, and above 1.5 means basic errors are dense, so polish the whole text before fixing item by item.
map.一般现在时第三人称单数动词加 -s（如 go→goes）: Add -s to present-tense third-person singular verbs (e.g. go → goes)
map.状语后的“的”应为“地”: The 的 after an adverb should be 地
map.修饰动词用“地”，如“慢慢地走”: Use 地 before a verb, e.g. 慢慢地走
map.动词后的“的”应为“得”: The 的 after a verb should be 得
map.动词后的程度补语用“得”，如“做得好”: Use 得 for a degree complement after a verb, e.g. 做得好
map.表示重复或又一次时用“再”，如“再次”“再见”: Use 再 for repetition or "again", e.g. 再次, 再见
map.表示乘坐时用“坐”: Use 坐 for riding or taking transport
